title: Bind Output transport authority to the Output credential, not an ambient session

claims.statement: Claude Code (claude-code) is the source-producing agent for CHG-0048 under human principal @rodrigoteamx, on the 2026-08-23 directive to continue with the deferred /ws session-precedence slice from CHG-0046. This does not authorize automatic merge of CHG-0048.
claims.evidence: AGENTS.md, profile.json actors and the 2026-08-23 user directive.

claims.statement: CHG-0046 recorded a deferred unknown: an interactive Studio session cookie presented on the /ws upgrade takes precedence over Output authentication because the handler authenticates the session before any application frame and rejects a later authenticate.output with ALREADY_AUTHENTICATED, so an Output page opened in a browser holding a same-origin Studio session runs on session authority. CHG-0046 merged to main at 637d280def3cb6bcb6ebf1a5efd7b06cb40d79dd (PR 45/46 lineage) with that unknown deferred.

The /ws transport is shared: the browser Output overlay (client/src/components/ProductionView.vue) sends authenticate.output as its first frame when its fragment carries an Output token, while the editor (editor/src/App.vue, editor/src/components/LayoutComposer.vue) and panel (panel/src/App.vue) send a channel or production subscribe as their first frame and rely on the Studio session cookie. The Studio shell itself does not connect to /ws; it drives production over REST.
claims.evidence: client, editor, panel and studio source at 637d280def3cb6bcb6ebf1a5efd7b06cb40d79dd.

claims.statement: Browser cookies are scoped by host, not by port or path, so a same-origin Output-and-Studio deployment, or local development, shares the session cookie across the Output page and Studio.
claims.evidence: RFC 6265 cookie scoping and the local development ports in client/vite.config.ts and studio/vite.config.ts.

claims.statement: An Output connection's authority must be declared by its Output credential, not inherited from ambient browser state. Governed discovery therefore reordered the fix from removing session authentication on /ws (which the editor and panel legitimately use) to making authenticate.output override any session-derived authority, so the fix is a strict de-escalation that leaves interactive surfaces untouched.
claims.evidence: Governed-discovery reorder check on 2026-08-23, ADR-0039, and the editor and panel first-frame subscribe behavior.

claims.statement: Treating authenticate.output as a de-escalation that overrides session authority, enrolls the socket for rotation, and fails closed on a bad token is the smallest correct fix that closes the credential-scoping leak for every credentialed Output connection without a client change and without weakening editor or panel session authority.
claims.evidence: The focused de-escalation, fail-closed, studio-preservation and rotation-retirement tests are the falsification mechanisms.

claims.statement: Human review accepted CHG-0048 for the exact de-escalation it implements: an authenticate.output frame on a connection that would otherwise hold Studio session authority installs read-only exact-Show Output authority, enrols the socket for Output-credential rotation, and denies Preview and mutation; a bad token fails closed without falling back to the session; a connection that never claims Output keeps its session authority and an already-output connection still rejects a repeated authenticate.output. Interactive editor and panel session authentication on the shared /ws transport is unchanged and the CHG-0046 branded-Chrome Output proof still reproduces its evidence.
claims.evidence: server/tests/unit/outputSessionPrecedence.test.ts (de-escalation, rotation retirement, fail-closed invalid token, studio preservation), the unchanged server/tests/unit/authHttp.test.ts WebSocket authentication test, the passing CHG-0046 e2e Output proof under npm run check, and human acceptance on 2026-08-23.

claims.statement: The fix is a server-only change to setupWebSocketHandler with no client, editor or panel change; the full server suite passed and the pull-request Constitution jobs passed with the OBS acceptance proof skipping on the OBS-less runners.
claims.evidence: server/src/handlers/websocket.ts diff, npm run check, and the CHG-0048 branch pull-request Constitution run.

claims.statement: A degenerate Output page loaded with no credential in its fragment sends no authenticate.output; if a same-origin Studio session cookie is present it is treated as an ordinary authenticated Studio connection. This is not a credentialed Output connection and is out of scope; a transport-level Output role declaration that would strip session authority even without a token is deferred.
claims.evidence: ADR-0039 scope and the Output client bootstrap behavior.

claims.statement: Whether a distinct Output transport identity (subprotocol or dedicated path) should replace the shared /ws endpoint remains unresolved and is deferred; this slice keeps the same-origin /ws derivation established by ADR-0037.
claims.evidence: ADR-0037 same-origin derivation and the deferred transport-identity question.

successCriteria.statement: An authenticate.output frame carrying a valid Output token on a connection that presents a valid Studio session cookie installs read-only, exact-Show Output authority, denies Preview and mutation, subscribes to Program, and is retired with policy code 1008 when the Output credential is rotated.
successCriteria.verification: Focused WebSocket test with a cookie-bearing connection that declares Output intent, asserts Program-only scope and rotation retirement.

successCriteria.statement: An authenticate.output frame carrying an invalid or retired token on a connection that presents a valid Studio session cookie closes the connection and does not fall back to session authority.
successCriteria.verification: Focused WebSocket test asserting the cookie-bearing connection closes on a bad Output token.

successCriteria.statement: A connection that presents a Studio session cookie and never sends authenticate.output retains Studio authority for channel and production subscriptions, and a connection already authenticated as Output rejects a repeated authenticate.output with ALREADY_AUTHENTICATED.
successCriteria.verification: Focused WebSocket tests for studio preservation and repeated-authentication rejection, plus the unchanged existing rotating-output-token test.

definitionOfDone.statement: ADR-0039 and CHG-0048 record authority, the shared-transport facts, the governed-discovery reorder, the de-escalation and fail-closed rules and the deferred scope before implementation.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Schema-valid records and deterministic governance compilation.

definitionOfDone.statement: setupWebSocketHandler treats authenticate.output as a de-escalation that overrides session authority and enrols the socket for rotation, with no client change and no weakening of editor or panel session authority.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Path-scoped implementation review of server/src/handlers/websocket.ts and unchanged client, editor and panel sources.

definitionOfDone.statement: Focused tests cover de-escalation from a session-bearing connection, fail-closed on an invalid token, studio preservation, repeated-authentication rejection and rotation retirement, and the existing WebSocket authentication tests still pass.
Governance, licensing, lint, type-check, focused and full tests, build, dependency audit and diff checks pass before handoff.
definitionOfDone.evidence: npm run governance:check, npm run check, npm run build, npm audit (0 vulnerabilities), ESLint and git diff --check; the accept commit is verified by its own pull-request Constitution run before merge.
